content: Nɛn bii, ɑ̀ n tii dɔrɑ ɑ nɛɛ, kɑɑ ɡoon dibu sɔbe, mɑ wunɛn ɡɑri yi nun yinɑ mwɑ,
ɑ duɑwɑ mi dibuɡii win nɔmɑ sɔɔ. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ doo ɑ nùn wɑ kpɑ ɑ nùn suuru kɑnɑ, ɑ tii yɑkiɑ win nɔmɑn di.
A ku nɛɛ, kɑɑ ɡinɑ kpunɑ ɑ wɛ̃rɑwɑ ɑ sere dɑ ɑ nùn suuru kɑnɑ.
A tii yɑkio kpɑ ɑ n tii mɔ nɡe mɛ nɛm tɑɑkɔ kɑ ɡunɔ nu rɑ kisire tɑɑson yinɑn di.
Bɑ yikuro kirɔ mɔ̀
Wunɛ yikuro, ɑ doo ɑ tɑmminu mɛɛri. A nin sɔmburu lɑɑkɑri koowo kpɑ ɑ wɑ ɑ bwisi ko.
Nu ǹ sunɔ mɔ, nu ǹ mɑɑ kpɑro mɔ, mɛyɑ nu ǹ mɑɑ wiruɡii mɔ,
ɑdɑmɑ nu rɑ nin dĩɑnu kɑsu nu yi ɡɛ̃ɛbun sɑnɑm kɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɑ̃rerun sɑɑ.
Wunɛ yikuro, sere dommɑ kɑɑ n kpĩ. Dommɑ kɑɑ dom se.
Wee, ɑ̀ n dom yĩburɑ ɑ dweeyɑ kɑ nɔm ɡbinnɑɑ fiiko,
sɑ̃ɑru tɑ koo nun deemɑ subɑru sɔɔ nɡe ɡbɛnɔ, kpɑ ɡɔ̃ɔru tu nun wɔri nɡe swɑɑ dio.
Tɔn kɔ̃son dɑɑ
Wi u ɡɑri weesuɡii kpɑrɑ, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ wi u kun ɡɑru mɔ̀, kɑ tɔn bɛrɛtɛkɛ.
U rɑ tɔmbu nɔni yɑ̃ɑkinu kue, kpɑ u yĩreru ko kɑ nɑɑsu, kɑ mɑɑ nɔmɑ, u kɑ bu nɔni wɔ̃ke.
Kɔ̃sɑn kobɑ bu rɑ n nùn nɛni, kpɑ u n yen sɔɔru mɔ̀ bɑɑdommɑ u n sɑnnɔsu seeyɑmɔ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ ɑsɔrɔ yɑ koo nùn deemɑ subɑru sɔɔ, kpɑ n kun koore bu nùn seeyɑ.
Ye Yinni Gusunɔ u tusɑ
Gɑ̃ɑnu nɔɔbɑ tiɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u tusɑ, u ku rɑ nu wɑɑbu kɑ̃. Niyɑ,
Gɑ̃ɑnu nɔɔbɑ yiruse mɑm wɑ̃ɑ. Niyɑ,
Kirɔbɑ sɑkɑrɑrun sɔ̃
Nɛn bii durɔbu, ɑ wunɛn tundon ɡere mɛm nɔɔwɔ, kpɑ ɑ kɑ wunɛn mɛron sɔ̃ɔsiru sɔmburu ko.
A n ye kpuro nɛni bɑɑdommɑ wunɛn ɡɔ̃ruɔ, kpɑ ɑ ye doke wĩirɔ nɡe wurɑ.
Yɑ koo nun kpɑrɑ wunɛn sɑnu sɑnusu sɔɔ, kpɑ yu nun kɔ̃su wunɛn kpin yerɔ. Yɑ koo mɑɑ nun bwisi kɛ̃ ɑ̀ n dom yɑndɑ.
Domi ɡere ye, yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe fitilɑ, mɑ sɔ̃ɔsi te, tɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe yɑm bururɑm. Ben kirɔ yɑ rɑ mɑɑ nun wɑ̃ɑrun swɑɑ sɔ̃ɔsiwɑ.
Yɑ koo nun ɡbɑrɑ kurɔ tɑnɔn nɔmɑn di. Yɑ koo nun yɑrɑ win ɡɑri dorin di.
A ku kurɔ win bweseru binɛ ko win burɑm sɔ̃. A ku de u nun kɔkiri kɑ win durɔ nɔni.
Kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ kurɔ tɑnɔ wɑ kɑ ɡobi fiiko, ɑdɑmɑ ɑ̀ n kɑ kurɔ mɔro kpunɑ, wunɛn wɑ̃ɑru kpurowɑ kɑɑ biɑ.
Kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ dɔ̃ɔ kpɛ̃ɛ bɔɔrɔ wunɛn yɑ̃nu nu kun dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑre?
Kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ sĩ dɔ̃ɔ ɡɛ̃ɛ wɔllɔ wunɛn nɑɑsu su kun dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑre?
Nɡe mɛyɑ ɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ ɑ ɡoon kurɔ bɑbɑ bɑ kun nun sɛɛyɑsie.
Goo ù n dĩɑnu ɡbɛnɑ yèn sɔ̃ ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ nùn mɔ̀, bɑ ku rɑ nùn ɡɔburu wɑ.
Kɑ mɛ, u koo kɔsiɑwɑ n kere ye u ɡbɛnɑ. Ye u mɔ win yɛnuɔ kpuro, yerɑ u koo wɛ̃.
Adɑmɑ wi u tɔn kurɔ kɔkurɑ u kɑ nùn sɑkɑrɑru kuɑ, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ. Domi wi u yen bweseru mɔ̀, wiyɑ u koo kɑm ko.
Bɑ koo nùn so kpɑ u bɛɛrɛ biɑ. Sekuru sɔɔrɑ u ko n wɑ̃ɑ bɑɑdommɑ.
Kpɑnnɑsirɑ koo de kurɔ win durɔ u mɔru se. U koo yɛ̃ro mɔru kɔsiɑwɑ u kun win wɔnwɔndu kue.
U ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu mwɑɑmɔ kɔsire, u ǹ mɑɑ suuru mɔ̀, bɑɑ bɑ̀ n nùn kɛ̃nu tɑɑsi.
Kirɔ kurɔ sɑkɑrɑ kowon sɔ̃
